EnLite C 5000mAh Power Bank | EVM P0309

The EnLite C 5000mAh Power Bank | EVM P0309 is a compact, efficient, and reliable charging solution designed for users who need dependable power on the go. With a capacity of 5000mAh 3.7V (18.5Wh), this power bank is ideal for daily use, short trips, office work, and emergency backup charging. Built with advanced Li-polymer battery technology, it ensures enhanced safety, durability, and long-lasting performance.

Featuring a modern Type-C input and versatile output options, the EnLite C 5000mAh power bank supports fast and stable charging for a wide range of devices including smartphones, wireless earbuds, fitness bands, and other USB-powered gadgets. Its slim profile and lightweight design make it easy to carry in your pocket, backpack, or handbag without adding bulk.

Powerful 5000mAh Capacity for Everyday Charging

The EnLite C 5000mAh | EVM P0309 offers an optimal balance between portability and performance. With a 5000mAh 3.7V (18.5Wh) capacity, it can charge most smartphones up to one full cycle, making it perfect for daily commuters, students, and professionals. The high-quality Li-polymer battery delivers consistent output while minimizing overheating and power loss.

Fast & Reliable Type-C Input and Output

Designed to meet modern charging standards, this power bank comes with a Type-C input rated at DC 5V/2.0A, enabling faster recharging compared to traditional micro-USB ports. The Type-C output (DC 5V/2.4A) ensures efficient power delivery to compatible devices, reducing charging time and improving overall convenience.

Built-in Lightning Cable Output

The integrated Lightning cable output (DC 5V/2.4A) makes the EnLite C 5000mAh an excellent choice for Apple device users. There is no need to carry extra cables, making this a clean and clutter-free charging solution for iPhone and other Lightning-supported devices.

Premium Li-Polymer Battery Technology

Equipped with a Li-polymer battery, the C 5000mAh | EVM P0309 provides improved safety, longer life cycles, and a lighter build compared to conventional batteries. Li-polymer cells are known for their stable performance and resistance to overcharging, ensuring your devices stay protected at all times.

Key Features

  • Capacity: 5000mAh 3.7V (18.5Wh)
  • Battery Type: Li-polymer
  • Type-C Input: DC 5V/2.0A
  • Type-C Output: DC 5V/2.4A
  • Lightning Cable Output: DC 5V/2.4A
  • Compact, lightweight, and travel-friendly design
  • Safe charging with built-in protection circuits
  • Ideal for smartphones, earbuds, and USB devices

The stands out as a reliable and efficient portable charger for users who value quality and convenience. Its universal compatibility, fast charging support, and premium battery construction make it suitable for both personal and professional use. Whether you are traveling, attending meetings, or simply need backup power during the day, this delivers consistent performance.

With growing demand for 5000mAh, Type-C power banks, and portable chargers with Lightning output, the EnLite C EVM P0309 meets modern user expectations while following global safety and efficiency standards. Its thoughtful design and dependable output make it a smart investment for everyday charging needs.
